P.name: Arcane Mastery
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ryze''' increases his {{as|{{sti|mana|'''maximum''' mana}}}} by {{as|(10% per 100 AP)}}.

Q.name: Overload
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Ryze's''' other {{tip|ability|basic ability}} casts reset ''Overload's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and charge a [[File:Overload 3.png|20px|link=]] ''Rune'' {{tip|stack}} for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 2 times.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ryze''' unleashes a runic blast in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and consumes all [[File:Overload 4.png|20px|link=]] ''Rune'' stacks.
Q.description3: If '''Ryze''' consumed 2 stacks, he gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.
Q.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Spell Flux|Ryze|Flux}} Bonus:}} ''Overload'' deals {{pp|type=[[File:Realm Warp.png|20px|border]] ''Realm Warp's'' Rank|key=%|25 to 100 for 4|0 to 3}} {{ccs|increased damage|magic}} and spreads to surrounding ''Fluxed'' enemies.

W.name: Rune Prison
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ryze''' seizes the target enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 50% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Spell Flux|Ryze|Flux}} Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|root|rooted}} instead of {{tip|slow|slowed}}.

E.name: Spell Flux
E.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Ryze''' projects an orb upon the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}.

The target and surrounding enemies are also marked with ''Flux'' for 4 seconds. '''Ryze's''' basic abilities against ''Flux'' targets consume the mark to become empowered with an additional effect.

R.name: Realm Warp
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ryze''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for 2 seconds to open a portal beneath him, marking the target location as its destination and granting {{tip|sight}} of the target area. '''Ryze''' is able to act while channeling, but the portal will cancel if he is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
R.description3: Upon completion, '''Ryze''' and all allied units within the portal will {{tip|blink}} to the location and become {{tip|root|rooted}}, {{tip|disarm|disarmed}}, {{tip|silence|silenced}} and {{tip|untargetable}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.75}}|Estimated}} seconds.
